Summary: SMB content platform focused on high-volume marketing content (emails, ad variants, landing copy). Inbound via blog + webinar. Self-serve orientation — wants to stay on hosted API if costs make sense.

Key user signals:
- Generating large batches: 20–200K tokens/day initially, expected seasonality spikes up to 1M tokens/day during campaigns.
- Very cost-sensitive: primary eval criteria = $/token at 50–500K monthly volume. Asked for examples of batching + caching savings.
- Interested in prefix & KV cache, continuous batching, and best-practice config for per-route latencies.
- Latency targets: average response for single-shot generation ~200–500ms acceptable for UI; bulk batch jobs can be async.
- Model preference: open model variants OK; wants fallback to cheaper quantized variants during cost-constrained runs.

Security & compliance: SMB but has enterprise clients; legal asked for SOC2 summary, SSO/SAML support, audit logs. Prefer public cloud deployment; no on-prem desire.
